OWNER_GO

BASELINE_SHA=ee5815872fcce91c242f1b33c655558927d9e8fe
WORK_PACKAGE=PHASE_24_REPRESENTATION_FEEDBACK_LOOP_C_CLOSURE
AUTHORIZATION=GO

Execute the largest coherent bounded Phase-24 work package up to the next
REAL authority, semantic, or technical blocker.

OBJECTIVE
Close Loop C by consuming the Phase-23 LEARNING_REPRESENTATION route as
bounded Learning research/adaptation input and proving that this consumption
can generate the next Learning evidence without creating self-modifying
productive Learning or any trading/productive authority.

CANONICAL TARGET

LEARNING REPRESENTATION
  -> OPTIMIZATION EVIDENCE
  -> META-LEARNING
  -> META_EVIDENCE_V1[LEARNING_REPRESENTATION]
  -> PHASE-23 DUAL ROUTER
  -> LEARNING_RESEARCH_ADAPTATION_INPUT
  -> BOUNDED LEARNING RESEARCH / ADAPTATION CHOICE
  -> NEW LEARNING EVIDENCE
  -> next cycle

LOOP_C_PROVEN may become true ONLY when this complete typed path is proven
against CURRENT and deterministic replay evidence.

REQUIRED BASELINE
1. Revalidate origin/main == BASELINE_SHA.
2. Re-read CURRENT Master Runbook and applicable authority pins.
3. Re-prove Phase 23 on CURRENT main before mutation.
4. Census the CURRENT Learning research/adaptation topology before adding
   any new owner or state.
5. Reuse CURRENT Learning owners/contracts wherever semantically valid.
6. Do not infer missing implementation from the Blueprint.
7. If closure requires a new productive owner, authority expansion,
   ambiguous mutation semantics, or another Owner decision:
   STOP and report the exact blocker.

A. PHASE-23 INPUT BOUNDARY
Reuse, do not duplicate:
- META_EVIDENCE_V1
- semantic_routing_class=LEARNING_REPRESENTATION
- LEARNING_RESEARCH_ADAPTATION_INPUT route
- canonical_meta_to_learning_research_adaptation_input_v1
- Phase-23 identity/provenance/replay semantics

Prove Phase-24 consumption starts downstream of the established Phase-23
routing boundary.

B. BOUNDED LEARNING CONSUMPTION
Materialize or bind the minimum CURRENT-compatible Learning research/adaptation
consumer necessary to interpret LEARNING_REPRESENTATION evidence.

Permitted semantic purposes include evidence-backed research choices about:
- feature usefulness
- feature/context redundancy
- context-family usefulness
- regime conditionality
- coverage weakness
- representation drift
- repeatedly failed representation hypotheses

The consumer may produce a bounded research/adaptation CHOICE or PLAN.

It MUST NOT directly mutate productive Learning state.

C. EXPLICIT PLAN/APPLY SEPARATION
Where CURRENT architecture supports the distinction, make it mechanically
explicit:

META EVIDENCE
  -> RESEARCH/ADAPTATION INPUT
  -> RESEARCH/ADAPTATION PLAN
  -> OFFLINE/BOUNDED EVALUATION
  -> NEW LEARNING EVIDENCE

and NOT:

META EVIDENCE
  -> PRODUCTIVE FEATURE/MODEL/PARAMETER MUTATION

Any representation change being evaluated must remain research/evidence
semantics unless a separately existing CURRENT authority explicitly says
otherwise.

D. NEXT-EVIDENCE GENERATION
Prove that an admissible LEARNING_REPRESENTATION record can affect the
bounded next Learning research/adaptation choice and lead to a subsequent
typed Learning evidence artifact.

Preserve:
- source meta-evidence identity
- route identity
- adaptation/research choice identity
- information-set / dataset identity where applicable
- feature/context version lineage
- provenance
- iteration/cycle identity
- deterministic replay

Do not fabricate market outcomes merely to claim closure.
Use deterministic fixtures/replay where appropriate and classify any
unavailable real evidence honestly.

E. LOOP-C REPLAY
Prove deterministic replay of the complete Phase-24 closure path:

source optimization/representation evidence
 -> meta ingest
 -> LEARNING_REPRESENTATION classification
 -> Phase-23 route
 -> Learning research/adaptation input
 -> bounded research/adaptation choice
 -> next Learning evidence

Required:
- identical source/input identities produce stable routing and choice identity
- provenance is preserved end-to-end
- cycle/iteration lineage is explicit
- replay cannot silently change the chosen research action
- malformed/stale/unsupported input fails closed according to CURRENT contracts

F. NEGATIVE / SAFETY PROOFS
Explicitly prove that Phase 24 cannot directly:
- add/drop a productive feature
- mutate productive feature configuration
- mutate productive model weights
- mutate productive thresholds/parameters
- mutate trading configuration
- alter Cap 2.3 selection/ranking
- alter MV2/Double Play decision authority
- alter Risk/Sizing
- alter Execution
- authorize promotion
- write productive configuration
- create an external effect
- turn Meta-Learning into a trading gate

No implicit self-modifying Learning path is permitted.

G. FAILURE / REJECTION EVIDENCE
Where consistent with CURRENT topology, rejected or inadmissible
representation adaptations must remain typed evidence suitable for subsequent
Learning/Optimization/Meta analysis.

Do not silently discard:
- redundancy rejection
- insufficient evidence
- unstable OOS result
- coverage failure
- drift incompatibility
- unsupported representation family

Do not broaden Phase 24 into a new optimization campaign merely to populate
these cases.

HARD PINS
META_EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY=NONE
META_FEEDBACK_IS_EVIDENCE_NOT_AUTHORITY=true
NO_SELF_MODIFYING_LEARNING=true
NO_DIRECT_FEATURE_DROP=true
NO_DIRECT_PARAMETER_MUTATION=true
NO_TRADING_GATE_FROM_META=true

OPTIMIZATION_PROMOTION_AUTHORITY=NONE
OPTIMIZATION_DIRECT_PRODUCTIVE_WRITE=FORBIDDEN
NO_AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION=true
NO_SELF_DEPLOY=true

MARKET_CONTEXT_AUTHORITY=NONE
CROSS_MARKET_IS_CONTEXT_ONLY=true
MV2_DP_UNCHANGED=true
NO_AUTHORITY_EXPANSION=true

OUT_OF_SCOPE
- Phase 25 DP Attribution
- Phase 26 Final Closed-Cycle DoD
- Registry-pointer repair
- productive feature rollout
- productive model retraining/deployment
- productive parameter admission
- promotion automation
- risk/sizing changes
- selection/ranking changes
- MV2/Double Play mutation
- WebSocket strategy redesign
- live/testnet/external-effect enablement
- unrelated cleanup/refactoring

PHASE_24 EXIT CRITERIA
Phase 24 may be PROVEN_COMPLETE only if CURRENT evidence proves:

PHASE_23_PREREQUISITE_PROVEN=true
LEARNING_REPRESENTATION_INPUT_BOUND=true
BOUNDED_LEARNING_ADAPTATION_CONSUMER_PROVEN=true
META_TO_LEARNING_EVIDENCE_ONLY=true
RESEARCH_ADAPTATION_PLAN_SEPARATE_FROM_PRODUCTIVE_APPLY=true
NEXT_LEARNING_EVIDENCE_GENERATION_PROVEN=true
LOOP_C_DETERMINISTIC_REPLAY=true
LOOP_C_PROVENANCE_PRESERVED=true
LOOP_C_ITERATION_LINEAGE_PROVEN=true
NO_SELF_MODIFYING_LEARNING=true
NO_DIRECT_PRODUCTIVE_MUTATION=true
NO_TRADING_AUTHORITY_EXPANSION=true
NO_AUTHORITY_EXPANSION=true

Only if all required closure evidence is genuinely present:

LOOP_C_PROVEN=true

Otherwise:
LOOP_C_PROVEN=false
and report the exact earliest blocker.

IMPORTANT SEMANTIC LIMIT
LOOP_C_PROVEN means the bounded evidence/research feedback cycle is closed.
It MUST NOT mean:
- productive feature auto-application
- autonomous model mutation
- productive retraining/deployment
- promotion
- trading adaptation

VALIDATION
Run:
- focused Phase-24 tests
- Phase-23 regression/replay tests
- directly affected Learning/Optimization/Meta integration tests
- authority/governance negative tests
- relevant deterministic replay tests
- Map Currency validation
- Atlas validation
- repository-required selector/gates for the final diff

Prefer one coherent PR if no genuine blocker requires an earlier stop.

DELIVERY
Do not merge.

Return:
- baseline SHA and final HEAD
- branch and PR number
- CURRENT owners/contracts reused
- any new bounded contracts/owners and why they were necessary
- exact Loop-C writer/router/reader/consumer/evidence chain
- plan-vs-apply boundary
- deterministic replay evidence
- next-Learning-evidence proof
- rejection/failure semantics
- negative authority evidence
- focused + affected test results
- Map/Atlas status
- exact Phase-24 DoD adjudication
- LOOP_C_PROVEN status
- next genuine blocker

HARD STOP
NO MERGE.
NO PHASE_25.
NO PHASE_26.
NO REGISTRY_POINTER_REPAIR.
NO ADDITIONAL WORKSTREAM.
</user_query>
